verdict.rationale: The IRS documents credentialed system-to-system intake channels: MeF XML transmission via Authorized e-file Provider enrollment (up to 45 days, fingerprinting), and IRIS A2A gated by a Transmitter Control Code. That gives a gated credential-issuance path, but these are filing rails, not a public data API, and probes found no OpenAPI or other published endpoint spec. The only stated limits apply to the browser-based EIN assistant, not to an API. Missing for 10: a public data API, published endpoint documentation, self-serve key issuance, and API rate limits stated on IRS pages.
